fit_scope: Separate model for each rental-area/property series; no pooled cross-LGA training.
calendar_encoding: Known target calendar quarter: Q2/Q3/Q4 binary indicators; Q1 is reference.

preprocessing.fit_scope: Only training examples at each LGA/origin; all seven inputs are standardized.

training_window: Expanding; supervised target quarters strictly earlier than the forecast target.
missing_lag_policy: Require consecutive observed history; omit exactly the first four warm-up targets per series. No filling or random split.
prediction_transform: None; forecast the nominal level directly. No clipping or log transform.
selection_policy: One fixed specification, declared before this experiment is scored. No grid search, model selection, or alpha tuning in this notebook.
aggregation: Every LGA-quarter receives equal weight; report pooled, per-LGA, and per-quarter errors.
holdout_policy: Reserve 2023Q4-2025Q3 from model selection and forecast-error scoring in notebook 10. Structural checks read the complete input; prior EDA has already displayed these values.
vintage_limit: Single 2025Q3 workbook vintage; publication lags and historical revisions are not reconstructed. This is period-based retrospective evaluation, not a real-time backtest.
deployment_policy: Research only; no live-app, packaged-data, registry, or recommendation changes.
